meta.title: EnRentAuto — premium car rental
meta.description: Daily rental of premium cars. Transparent rates, delivery within 60 minutes, insurance included.

home.title2: For exactly as long as you need it.
home.subtitle: Daily rental of business and premium class cars. Our own fleet, full insurance and delivery anywhere in the city.
home.popularEmpty: The fleet is empty. Add cars in the admin panel.
home.whyTitle: A service you don't need to figure out
home.advFastD: We bring the car anywhere in the city or to the airport. No extra charge within city limits.
home.advInsD: Full coverage is already in the price. You don't pay for risks — you just drive.
home.advPriceD: The daily price is fixed at booking. No hidden fees.
home.advFleetD: Every car goes through a pre-trip inspection and detailing before handover.
home.step1D: Set the rental period — we'll show only the cars that are free.
home.step2D: Fill in the form: name, contacts and documents. Two minutes.
home.step3D: A manager confirms the booking and agrees the delivery point.
home.ctaText: We'll match a model to your route and budget.
